tagline: 理光数码相机，2009 年发布
description: 理光于2009年推出的数码相机。配备Focal length 6.0 mm (equivalent to 28 mm for 135 film cameras), 8 elements in 6 groups (two aspherical lenses/two aspherical surfaces)。快门速度180, 120, 60, 30, 15, 13, 10, 8, 6, 5, 4, 3.2, 2.5, 2, 1.6, 1.3, 1 - 1/2000 sec。感光度Auto, Auto-hi, 80, 100, 200, 400, 800, 1600。Multi-AF (CCD method), Spot-AF (CCD method), Manual focus, snap, infinity (focus lock and AF auxiliary light also available)。

specs.镜头: Focal length 6.0 mm (equivalent to 28 mm for 135 film cameras), 8 elements in 6 groups (two aspherical lenses/two aspherical surfaces)
specs.光圈: f/1.9 to f/9 (+f/8.0-f/11 in auto mode is with ND filter)
specs.对焦: Multi-AF (CCD method), Spot-AF (CCD method), Manual focus, snap, infinity (focus lock and AF auxiliary light also available)
specs.尺寸: 108.6 x 59.8 x 25.5 mm (W x H x D); does not include protruding parts
specs.重量: Approx.188 g (excluding battery, SD Memory Card, hand strap)
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh GR Digital III has been introduced by Ricoh in 2009.
